chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The Day of Judgement is near and our mutual company is short.

key_terms.الِاصْطِحَابُ: Mutual companionship, association, or holding onto one another in this world
key_terms.الْأَمْرُ: The matter, specifically referring to the Day of Judgement or the time of death/action

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali mean by 'the command is near and companionship is few'?
ai.summary: In this concise maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) juxtaposes the imminence of the Hour with the scarcity of righteous deeds (istihab), highlighting the urgency of spiritual preparation. This reflection underscores the Shia emphasis on *zuhd* (asceticism) and the transient nature of worldly life, urging believers to maximize their limited time for worship before the final reckoning.
